project.name: ros2_ly_ws_sentry
project.description: ROS2 Humble sentry workspace. Current formal runtime is decision-only: external sentry.aim/sentry_tf provide vision/TF and aim/fire gate; this repo owns BT decision, navigation/FaceMode bridge, gimbal_driver serial downlink, legacy debug auto-aim, and offline simulator.
project.lastCheckedNote: Fallback graph source-checked against the current dirty worktree. Covers composite GoalReachState, SentryPositionFusion, current DownlinkTypeID=0x00~0x04 frames, TypeID 6/10 referee mappings, sentry_info_3 posture timer priority with local fallback, and the 2026-07-12 project/regional detailed graph documents plus read-only local dashboard.

nodes.name: external sentry.aim
nodes.summary: External aim stack owns camera, detection, tracking, ballistic solve, follow/fire decision for the formal decision-only runtime.

nodes.name: external sentry_tf
nodes.summary: External TF provider preferred by formal runtime; repo `tf_tree` is fallback only.

nodes.name: lower machine
nodes.summary: Embedded lower machine receiving DownlinkTypeID-based serial frames from `gimbal_driver` (`0x00=13B control`, `0x01=6B sentry command`, `0x02=107B map path`, `0x03=36B custom info`, `0x04=17B sentry coordinate`) and returning referee/gimbal state.

nodes.name: decision-only runtime
nodes.summary: Current formal chain: repo runs gimbal_driver, navi_tf_bridge/FaceMode, behavior_tree; external sentry.aim/sentry_tf own vision and final aim/fire gates.

nodes.name: legacy internal auto-aim
nodes.summary: Historical/debug chain detector -> tracker_solver -> predictor -> behavior_tree/mapper -> control topics.

nodes.name: decision trace simulator contract
nodes.summary: Behavior-tree decision outputs feed the offline pygame simulator/replay contract.

nodes.name: composite GoalReachState contract
nodes.summary: BT internal current-goal reached/unreachable contract: scoped external /ly/navi/reached and /ly/navi/reachable, fused sentry self-position distance, goal-start grace, and timeout are evaluated by EvaluateNaviGoalReach()/EvaluateBaseGoalReach().

nodes.name: SentryPositionFusion
nodes.summary: BT fuses sentry self position from UWB/radar, navi TF-derived position, and friend sentry PositionData. Default mode is priority with UWB > Navi > PositionData and 2000 ms freshness.

nodes.name: 2026-07-12_project_link_graph.md
nodes.summary: Current detailed project-wide topology: formal decision-only runtime, external boundaries, TypeID 6/10 mappings, downstream 0x00~0x04 frames, position/reached convergence, and legacy separation.

nodes.name: strategy_layers_and_navigation_reach.md
nodes.summary: Current regional strategy-layer and composite navigation reach contract documentation.

nodes.name: decision_framework.md
nodes.summary: Current regional decision framework and data-source semantics.

nodes.name: 2026-07-12_regional_decision_graph.md
nodes.summary: Detailed Regional decision topology: tick order, Hard/Task/Tactical/Special/Default priorities, navigation closed loop, speed_level versus control velocity responsibility, and posture timer/scoring/downlink.

nodes.name: Regional decision tick
nodes.summary: Regional executes UpdateGlobalData -> EvaluateEvents -> SelectAimMode -> SelectStrategyMode -> Hard -> Task -> PreprocessData -> SelectAimTarget -> Tactical -> Special -> Default -> Finalizer -> SelectPosture -> PublishAll.

nodes.name: Understand graph dashboard
nodes.summary: Read-only local HTTP dashboard. It serves the fallback knowledge-graph JSON and the two detailed graph documents without touching ROS runtime or graph files.

nodes.name: navi_status_topics.md
nodes.summary: External navigation status topic contract, including raw external sources and BT composite reach_state.

nodes.name: CustomInfo.msg
nodes.summary: ROS message schema `src/gimbal_driver/msg/CustomInfo.msg` for referee 0x0308 custom_info_t.

nodes.name: MapPath.msg
nodes.summary: ROS message schema `src/gimbal_driver/msg/MapPath.msg` for referee 0x0307 map_data_t.

nodes.name: /ly/control/custom_info
nodes.summary: ROS2 topic `/ly/control/custom_info` with message type `gimbal_driver/msg/CustomInfo`, serialized as DownlinkTypeID=0x03.

nodes.name: /ly/control/map_path
nodes.summary: ROS2 topic `/ly/control/map_path` with message type `gimbal_driver/msg/MapPath`, serialized as DownlinkTypeID=0x02.

nodes.name: /ly/navi/path
nodes.summary: External navigation path input. Remote navigation source confirms nav_msgs/Path in map frame with meter coordinates and header timestamp.

nodes.name: /ly/game/path
nodes.summary: Processed referee map path: official-map dm MapPath, intention=3, input nav_msgs/Path header timestamp preserved. gimbal_driver serializes it as DownlinkTypeID=0x02 only when the nonzero stamp is no older than game_path_fresh_timeout_ms (default 5000ms).

nodes.name: map_path_to_game_path_node.cpp
nodes.summary: Converts external nav_msgs/Path map-meter points into official-map dm MapPath using the inverse current MapPointer matrix; preserves header.stamp and recomputes 49 deltas.

nodes.name: /ly/enemy/op_hp
nodes.summary: ROS2 topic `/ly/enemy/op_hp` with message type `std_msgs::msg::UInt16`; gimbal_driver now prefers TypeID=10 precise 0x0003 enemy_outpost_HP and falls back to TypeID=1 GameCode * 25 only when TypeID=10 is not fresh.

nodes.name: /ly/friend/op_hp
nodes.summary: ROS2 topic `/ly/friend/op_hp` with message type `std_msgs::msg::UInt16`; gimbal_driver now prefers TypeID=10 precise 0x0003 ally_outpost_HP and falls back to TypeID=1 GameCode * 25 only when TypeID=10 is not fresh.

nodes.name: /ly/friend/uwb_pos
nodes.summary: Dedicated radar/UWB sentry self-position source for BT SentryPositionFusion; default highest priority source.

nodes.name: /ly/game/sentry/info
nodes.summary: ROS2 topic `/ly/game/sentry/info` with message type `gimbal_driver/msg/SentryInfo`; TypeID=7 publishes sentry_info/sentry_info_2 and TypeID=10 updates the sentry_info_3 shadow fields.

nodes.name: /ly/navi/position
nodes.summary: navi_tf_bridge publishes TF-derived sentry self position in official-map centimeters; BT uses it as the Navi source in SentryPositionFusion.

nodes.name: /ly/navi/reach_state
nodes.summary: BT publishes composite current-goal reach state with status/reason, goal scope, external reached/reachable freshness, fused self-position distance, grace, and timeout.

nodes.name: /ly/navi/reachable
nodes.summary: External navigation source: whether the current navigation goal has a valid route. BT scopes it to the current goal before using it in GoalReachState.

nodes.name: /ly/navi/reached
nodes.summary: External navigation reached source. It is not BT final reached; BT scopes it to the current goal and combines it with reachable and fused position in GoalReachState.

nodes.name: /ly/position/data
nodes.summary: Lower-machine/referee position data. The friend sentry slot is BT SentryPositionFusion's PositionData source; other unit positions feed decision state.

nodes.name: /ly/bt/sentry_position
nodes.summary: ROS2 topic `/ly/bt/sentry_position` with message type `geometry_msgs/msg/PointStamped`; BT publishes fused sentry self position in map frame (m) for gimbal_driver coordinate downlink.

nodes.name: PatrolScan YAML-centralized scan contract
nodes.summary: BT gimbal patrol scan mode selection is centralized in PatrolScan/TaskOverrides: default scan mode, FaceMode missing-angle fallback, Outpost fallback, damage-abort search mode, start-gate pitch offset, Outpost pitch offset, and Mode2's older 500 ms scan profile.

nodes.name: Patrol.yaml
nodes.summary: Canonical behavior_tree PatrolScan YAML: Mode1/2/3 scan curves and TaskOverrides for FaceMode/Outpost/start-gate patrol scan behavior. Mode2 uses the older 500 ms profile: yaw 1.0/1.1, pitch 0 +/- 13 deg, period 500 ms.

nodes.name: Task.yaml
nodes.summary: Behavior-tree task switches. FaceMode fallback patrol scan modes are no longer configured here; comments point to Patrol.yaml.

nodes.name: OutpostRegionalTest.yaml
nodes.summary: Outpost debug profile that overrides PatrolScan.TaskOverrides.OutpostFaceModeFallbackMode to mode 3 for high-scan testing.

nodes.name: Configuration.cpp
nodes.summary: Parses and validates behavior_tree JSON/YAML/ROS parameter configuration, including PatrolScan.TaskOverrides and legacy FaceMode patrol-key mirrors.

nodes.name: GameLoop.cpp
nodes.summary: Main behavior_tree runtime loop; selects patrol scan mode for no-target, FaceMode fallback, Outpost fallback, and damage-abort scan branches.

nodes.name: WaitBeforeGame.cpp
nodes.summary: Start-gate wait loop; when gimbal patrol before start is enabled, applies PatrolScan mode curves and PatrolScan.TaskOverrides start-gate pitch offset.

nodes.name: patrol_scan_modes.md
nodes.summary: Current patrol scan mode documentation: Patrol.yaml canonical config, mode 1/2/3 behavior, Mode2 500 ms rollback, runtime selection priority, pitch offsets, legacy key compatibility, and link chain.

nodes.name: vision_task_patrol_modes.md
nodes.summary: Regional mode overview distinguishing vision mode, task mode, gimbal patrol scan, regional patrol, FollowMode, and FaceMode.

nodes.name: PatrolScan TaskOverrides
nodes.summary: Behavior-tree patrol scan task override contract: FaceMode missing-angle fallback, Outpost FaceMode fallback, Outpost damage-abort scan mode, start-gate pitch offset, and Outpost no-target pitch offset are centralized under Patrol.yaml PatrolScan.TaskOverrides.

nodes.name: patrolmode_pub.py
nodes.summary: Manual PatrolScan-style /ly/control/angles publisher for gimbal downlink testing; reads Patrol.yaml mode parameters and OutpostPitchOffsetDeg for --outpost.

tour.title: 从当前主链开始
tour.description: 先看 README 和系统行为文档：正式运行已经是 decision-only，本仓不再启动 legacy 内部自瞄链。

tour.title: 理解 BT 的 ROS 边界
tour.description: 看 Topic.hpp 和 Application.cpp：BT 订阅外部 aim/裁判/导航状态，统一发布 /ly/control/* 和导航意图。

tour.title: 追踪正式 aim/fire 控制流
tour.description: 外部 sentry.aim 发布候选目标和 AimResult，BT 根据 follow/fire 门控决定角度接管与 firecode 翻转。

tour.title: 看下位机和裁判状态边界
tour.description: gimbal_driver 消费 /ly/control/*，发布 /ly/gimbal/*、/ly/game/*、/ly/friend/* 等状态，是 ROS 与下位机的边界。

tour.title: 看导航和 FaceMode bridge
tour.description: navi_tf_bridge 把 BT 的 raw/relative 目标转成 /goal_pose，也把 FaceMode target raw 解成 /ly/face_mode/angles。

tour.title: 区分 legacy 调试链
tour.description: detector/tracker_solver/predictor/outpost/buff 仍保留，但作为调试、标定和历史对照，不是 sentry_all 正式主链。

tour.title: 维护 simulator trace 合约
tour.description: 改 BT 决策输出、trace schema、点位、posture 或 unit state 时，同步 simulator model/trace/validation/config/docs。
